The [[human replica droid]] known as '''Stanton Rendar''' was a recreation of a deceased [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] of the [[Stanton Rendar|same name]].

==History==
Years after [[Stanton Rendar|the original Stanton]] was killed in a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crash on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], his brother [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash]] met [[Guri]], a highly advanced [[human replica droid]] (HRD). When Dash learned of Guri's origins, he partnered with her to create [[Onadax Droid Technologies]] (ODT), a company that later developed a process to place the essence of a living being into an HRD. He somehow used this technology to recreate Stanton.

The droid version of Stanton considered himself to be the true Stanton in a new body, and eventually became the head of ODT. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] was investigating the origins of the human replica droid that [[Bakura/Legends|Bakuran]] [[Prime Minister (Bakura)|Prime Minister]] [[Molierre Cundertol|Cundertol]] infused his essence into. Her [[Mission to Onadax|investigation]] led her to [[Onadax Droid Technologies headquarters|ODT's headquarters]] on [[Onadax]], in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].

On Onadax, Solo confronted Stanton concerning the morality of granting [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] to sentients through droids and attempted to persuade him to surrender himself to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Stanton, unconvinced, unleashed his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on Jaina to create a diversion. The ensuing battle destroyed the ODT factory, but Stanton managed to escape.
